metadata.mechanics: Requires 3 members of the same society and a Target of the same society of equal or lower rank. Each of the 3 members engage in a shared total of 10 minutes of roleplay condemning the Target and spending 1 Resolve each to remove a shared "Society Membership" from the lower or equal ranking member.
metadata.notes: A Guide should be present to take note of this procedure's performance and, in the case of PCs being removed from a Society, ensure that the removal is placed on the character's sheet if not present.
metadata.requirementsToUse: 3 participants who share a common Society Membership and are of equal or higher rank in that Society as the Target.
metadata.validTargetDescription: Lineage Target that shares a specific Society Membership with all participants.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: The condemnation of a member from an organization and their exile from its ranks takes many forms depending on the culture of the society in question. A society focused on law enforcement may hold a literal trial, potentially with the dismissed member not even present, while a less-tightly organized group may simply meet around a table and shit-talk the accused for some time. Use of this procedure for petty or personal reasons may result in higher-ups in the organization taking notice.
